examples.en: The solar system has eight planets.
They say an object from outside the solar system was found.
In elementary school, I made a model of the solar system.

examples.ko: 지구는 태양계에서 태양과 세 번째로 가까워요.
examples.en: Earth is the third closest to the sun in the solar system.
I wonder where the edge of the solar system is.

examples.ko: 태양계 그림을 보고 행성 이름을 외웠어요.
examples.en: I memorized the planets' names by looking at a picture of the solar system.

explain: 범위로 보면 우주 > 은하 > 태양계 > 지구 순서로 작아져요. 태양계는 우리 해를 중심으로 한 범위만 가리켜서 우주 전체와는 달라요. 보통 '태양계 행성', '태양계 밖'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: I memorized the names of the solar system planets in order.
phrases.nuance_ko: 태양 주위를 도는 행성을 말할 때 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common pairing for planets orbiting the sun.

phrases.en: The sun is the center of the solar system.
phrases.nuance_ko: '의'를 붙여 태양계에 속한 것이나 성질을 설명해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '의' describes something belonging to the solar system.

phrases.example: 지구는 태양계 안에서 세 번째 행성이에요.
phrases.en: Earth is the third planet in the solar system.
phrases.nuance_ko: '밖'과 반대로 태양계 범위 안을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The opposite of 'outside', meaning within the solar system.

explain_en: By scale it shrinks in the order 우주 > 은하 > 태양계 > 지구. 태양계 covers only the area around our sun, so it is not the same as the whole universe. It is usually used as 태양계 행성 or 태양계 밖.

examples.en: We passed through a boundless plain by train.
Mongolia has many wide plains.
A herd of horses galloped across the plain.
The sunset seen from the plain is really beautiful.
I want to visit the North American plains.
Plains are good for farming.

explain: 산이 거의 없이 넓고 평평한 땅이에요. '평야'와 비슷한 말이고, '평원'은 탁 트인 넓은 풍경을 말할 때 잘 어울려요.

phrases.example: 이 지역은 평야가 넓어서 쌀농사가 잘돼요.
phrases.en: This area has wide plains, so rice farming goes well.
phrases.nuance_ko: '평원'과 비슷한 말인데 농사짓는 넓은 들을 말할 때 더 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to '평원', but fits better for wide farmland.

phrases.en: Horses are running across the wide plain.
phrases.nuance_ko: 탁 트인 풍경을 말할 때 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing when describing an open landscape.

phrases.en: The train runs across the plain.
phrases.nuance_ko: 이동하는 장면을 말할 때 붙여 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for describing movement through the landscape.

explain_en: It is wide, flat land with almost no mountains. It is close to '평야', and '평원' suits descriptions of open, far-reaching scenery.

examples.ko: 이 협약에는 백 개가 넘는 가맹국이 서명했어요.
examples.en: More than a hundred member countries signed this agreement.

examples.ko: 유엔 가맹국은 모두 회의에 참석할 수 있어요.
examples.en: All UN member countries can attend the meeting.

examples.ko: 우리나라는 그 기구의 가맹국이 된 지 십 년이 됐어요.
examples.en: It has been ten years since our country became a member of that organization.

examples.ko: 가맹국끼리 무역 문제를 놓고 회의를 열었어요.
examples.en: The member countries held a meeting about trade issues.
They decide by vote whether to accept a new member country.

examples.ko: 가맹국에는 회비를 내야 할 의무가 있어요.
examples.en: Member countries have a duty to pay membership fees.

explain: 국제기구나 조약에 가입한 나라를 말하고, 뉴스나 수업에서 주로 나와요. 같은 뜻으로 '회원국'이 더 쉽고 자주 들려요. 프랜차이즈의 '가맹점'과 같은 '가맹'이 들어 있어요.

phrases.en: Our country is a member country of that organization.
phrases.nuance_ko: '가맹국'과 같은 뜻이지만 더 쉽고 자주 들려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 가맹국, but easier and more common.

phrases.en: That country became a member last year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 국제기구나 조약에 새로 가입했을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a country newly joins an international organization or treaty.

phrases.en: Representatives of the member countries gathered in the meeting hall.
phrases.nuance_ko: 국제회의 뉴스에서 자주 나오는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing in news about international meetings.

explain_en: It refers to countries that have joined an international organization or treaty, and it mostly appears in news and lessons. '회원국' has the same meaning and is easier and more common to hear. It shares '가맹' with '가맹점', a franchise store.

examples.ko: 새 정부의 각료 명단이 오늘 발표됐어요.
examples.en: The new government's list of cabinet members was announced today.
The cabinet members discussed next year's budget at the meeting.

examples.ko: 그 정치인은 예전에 각료로 일한 경험이 있어요.
examples.en: That politician has experience working as a cabinet member.

examples.ko: 총리가 각료들에게 현장을 직접 살펴보라고 했어요.
examples.en: The prime minister told the cabinet members to check the site in person.
They say he was offered a cabinet post but turned it down.

examples.ko: 각료 세 명이 대통령과 함께 해외 순방길에 올랐어요.
examples.en: Three cabinet members set off on an overseas trip with the president.

explain: 한 사람을 부를 때는 '장관'이라고 하고, 각료는 '각료 회의', '각료 인선'처럼 장관들을 묶어서 말할 때 많이 써요. 뉴스와 정치 기사에서 자주 나오고 일상 대화에서는 드물어요.

phrases.en: The cabinet meeting is held every week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장관들이 모여 하는 회의를 말하고 뉴스에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A meeting of ministers; common in news.

phrases.en: The president announced the cabinet appointments.
phrases.nuance_ko: 누구를 장관으로 뽑을지 정하는 일을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The choosing of who will serve as ministers.

phrases.en: He was appointed as a cabinet member of the new government.
phrases.nuance_ko: 장관 자리에 정식으로 앉게 될 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when someone is formally given a ministerial post.
phrases.en_equiv: to be appointed to the cabinet

explain_en: For one person you say '장관' (minister); 각료 is used when talking about ministers as a group, as in '각료 회의' or '각료 인선'. It appears often in news and political articles but rarely in everyday talk.

examples.ko: 개도국에 학교를 짓는 봉사 활동에 참여했어요.
examples.en: I took part in a volunteer project building schools in developing countries.
Korea, too, used to be called a developing country.
The gap between developed and developing countries is still large.

examples.ko: 이번 회의에서 개도국 지원 문제를 다뤘어요.
examples.en: This meeting dealt with the issue of aid to developing countries.

examples.ko: 개도국 학생들을 위한 장학금이 새로 생겼어요.
examples.en: A new scholarship for students from developing countries was created.

examples.ko: 개도국은 기후 변화의 피해를 더 크게 입어요.
examples.en: Developing countries suffer greater damage from climate change.

explain: '개발도상국'의 줄임말이에요. 뉴스와 기사에서는 자주 보지만 말로 할 때는 '개발도상국'이라고 하는 경우도 많아요. 짝이 되는 말은 '선진국'이에요.

phrases.en: The government decided to increase support for developing nations.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뉴스에서 '개도국'과 가장 자주 함께 나오는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the most common pairing with '개도국' in the news.

phrases.en: I'm sending books to children in developing countries.
phrases.nuance_ko: '의'를 붙여 그 나라들에 사는 사람을 가리킬 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '의' points to the people living in those countries.

phrases.example: 개발도상국은 경제가 아직 성장하는 중인 나라예요.
phrases.en: A developing country is a country whose economy is still growing.
phrases.nuance_ko: '개도국'의 원래 말이고, 말로 할 때나 설명할 때 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the full form of '개도국' and is more common in speech and explanations.

explain_en: This is the shortened form of '개발도상국'. You often see it in news and articles, but in speech people often say the full '개발도상국'. Its counterpart is '선진국' (developed country).

examples.ko: 거국적 차원에서 이 문제를 풀어야 해요.
examples.en: We have to solve this problem at the level of the whole nation.

examples.ko: 나라 전체가 참여하는 거국적인 행사가 열려요.
examples.en: A nationwide event with the whole country taking part will be held.

examples.ko: 정부가 거국적으로 재난 극복 운동을 시작했어요.
examples.en: The government started a nationwide campaign to overcome the disaster.
During the World Cup, the whole nation was in a cheering mood.

examples.ko: 거국적 노력 없이는 쉽게 해결되지 않아요.
examples.en: It won't be easily solved without an effort by the whole nation.

examples.ko: 이번 사업은 거국적 지원이 꼭 필요해요.
examples.en: This project definitely needs support from the entire nation.

explain: 뒤에 '차원', '운동', '응원', '지원' 같은 명사가 와서 나라 전체가 한마음으로 한다는 느낌을 줘요. '거국적인', '거국적으로'로도 자주 써요. 일상 대화보다 뉴스나 연설에서 더 많이 들려요.

phrases.en: A nationwide campaign has started.
phrases.nuance_ko: 표제어에 '-인'을 붙여 명사를 꾸미는 형태로, 글에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The headword plus '-인' to modify a noun, common in writing.

phrases.en: The whole nation cheered for the athletes together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동사 앞에서 '나라 전체가 함께'라는 뜻을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Placed before a verb to add the sense of 'the whole nation together.'

phrases.en: The government promised nationwide support.
phrases.nuance_ko: '지원', '차원', '운동' 같은 명사와 함께 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing with nouns like support, level, or movement.

explain_en: It is followed by nouns like '차원', '운동', '응원' and '지원', giving the sense that the whole country acts as one. It is also commonly used as '거국적인' and '거국적으로'. You hear it more in news and speeches than in everyday talk.

examples.ko: 공복에 약을 먹으면 속이 아플 수 있어요.
examples.en: Taking medicine on an empty stomach can hurt your stomach.
I have a health checkup tomorrow, so I must go without eating.

examples.ko: 공복 혈당을 재려면 아침 식사 전에 해야 해요.
examples.en: To measure fasting blood sugar, you have to do it before breakfast.

examples.ko: 공복 상태로 열두 시간 있어야 해요.
examples.en: You have to stay fasting for twelve hours.

examples.ko: 공복일 때 마트에 가면 이것저것 많이 사요.
examples.en: When I go to the mart hungry, I buy a lot of things.
If I stay hungry for long, I get a headache.

explain: 밥을 먹지 않아 배가 빈 상태를 말해요. 병원이나 약 설명서에서 '공복에', '공복 혈당'처럼 자주 보여요. 말할 때는 '빈속'이 더 편하게 쓰이고, 반대로 밥 먹은 뒤는 '식후'라고 해요. 소리가 같은 '공복(公僕)'은 '공무원'을 뜻하는 다른 말이에요.

phrases.en: If I drink coffee on an empty stomach, my stomach burns.
phrases.nuance_ko: '공복'과 같은 뜻이에요. 일상 대화에서는 '빈속'을 더 편하게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 공복; 빈속 sounds more casual in daily talk.

phrases.en: I had my fasting blood sugar measured at the checkup.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밥을 먹지 않은 상태에서 잰 혈당이에요. 병원이나 건강검진에서 자주 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Blood sugar measured without eating; common at hospitals and health checkups.

phrases.en: I exercise on an empty stomach in the morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: 밥을 먹기 전에 무엇을 한다고 말할 때 '공복에' 뒤에 동사를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a verb after '공복에' to say what you do before eating.
phrases.en_equiv: to exercise on an empty stomach

explain_en: Literary, a government worker seen as serving the people. It means the stomach is empty because you have not eaten. You see '공복에' and '공복 혈당' in hospitals and on medicine labels. In casual speech 빈속 is more common, and the opposite is 식후 (after a meal). The homophone 공복(公僕) is a different word meaning 'public servant'.

t90.ax: You have to stay fasting for twelve hours.

examples.en: People and animals coexist in the city.
Several cultures coexisted in one country.
It is a street where tradition and modernity coexist.

examples.ko: 서로 다른 의견이 공존할 수 있어요.
examples.en: Different opinions can coexist.
To coexist with neighbors, you have to consider each other.
It was a day when sadness and joy coexisted.

explain: 'A와 B가 공존하다'처럼 서로 다른 것이 한곳에 함께 있을 때 써요. '같이 살다'는 사람과 동물의 생활에 쓰지만 공존하다는 생각이나 문화 같은 개념에도 써요. '공생하다'는 서로 도움을 주고받는 관계라서 달라요.

phrases.en: We have to coexist with nature.
phrases.nuance_ko: 'A와 공존하다' 형태로, 함께 있는 대상을 '와/과'로 나타내는 가장 기본적인 쓰임이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The basic pattern 'coexist with A', marking the other party with 와/과.

phrases.example: 옛 건물과 새 건물이 공존할 수 있어요.
phrases.en: Old buildings and new buildings can coexist.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가능을 나타내는 활용형으로, 서로 다른 것이 함께 있을 수 있다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A form expressing possibility, used when saying that different things can exist together.

phrases.example: 평화로운 공존을 위해 서로 이해해야 해요.
phrases.en: We need to understand each other for peaceful coexistence.
phrases.nuance_ko: 동사가 아니라 명사 '공존'으로 쓴 짝말이고, 글이나 연설에서 자주 나와요.
phrases.nuance_en: This uses the noun 공존 rather than the verb, and appears often in writing and speeches.

explain_en: Most common — people or beings living together in harmony. Use it as 'A와 B가 공존하다' when different things exist in the same place. 같이 살다 is for the living of people or animals, but 공존하다 also covers ideas and cultures. 공생하다 (symbiosis) is different: it means helping each other.

en: to give aid; to help; to give first aid

examples.en: The firefighters gave aid to the injured people.

examples.ko: 재난 지역의 주민들을 구호하는 단체에 기부했어요.
examples.en: I donated to an organization that gives relief to residents of disaster areas.

examples.ko: 먼저 부상자를 구호하고 나서 병원으로 옮겼어요.
examples.en: They first gave aid to the wounded and then moved them to the hospital.
There are not enough supplies to provide relief to the flood victims.

examples.ko: 적십자는 전쟁 난민을 구호하려고 현장에 갔어요.
examples.en: The Red Cross went to the site to help war refugees.

examples.ko: 사고 현장에서 다친 아이를 구호해 준 분이 있어요.
examples.en: Someone helped the injured child at the scene of the accident.

explain: '돕다'보다 훨씬 무겁고, 재난, 전쟁, 사고처럼 위험한 상황에서 사람을 구하고 돌볼 때만 써요. '구호 물품', '구호 단체'처럼 명사로도 많이 나와요. 슬로건 뜻의 '구호'는 한자가 다른 말이에요.

phrases.en: We loaded the relief supplies onto the truck.
phrases.nuance_ko: 재난 지역에 보내는 물건을 부르는 명사 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun collocation for goods sent to disaster areas.

phrases.en: I volunteer at a relief organization.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어려운 사람들을 돕는 단체를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for organizations that help people in need.

phrases.en: The victims are receiving aid.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도움을 받는 쪽에서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the side of those receiving help.

explain_en: Give first aid or relief to the injured or disaster victims. It is far heavier than '돕다' and is only used for rescuing and caring for people in dangerous situations such as disasters, wars, and accidents. It also appears as a noun in '구호 물품' (relief supplies) and '구호 단체' (relief organization). The '구호' meaning slogan is a different word with different Chinese characters.

examples.en: There is a military base near my house.
My older brother serves at a military unit in Gangwon Province.

examples.ko: 군부대 앞에서는 사진을 찍으면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You must not take photos in front of a military base.
The singers visited a military unit and performed.
During the flood, the military unit helped the village.

examples.ko: 군부대 근처에는 면회 온 가족을 위한 식당이 많아요.
examples.en: Near the base there are many restaurants for families who come to visit.

explain: 군인들이 모여 생활하고 훈련하는 단위나 그 장소를 말해요. '부대'라고 줄여서 말하기도 해요. 한국은 군 복무 문화가 있어서 '부대에 들어가다', '부대 면회'처럼 자주 들려요.

phrases.en: My older brother is living at his unit now.
phrases.nuance_ko: '군부대'를 줄인 말로, 말할 때 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shortened form of 군부대, more common in speech.

phrases.en: I am going to visit a soldier at the military base this weekend.
phrases.nuance_ko: 군대에 있는 가족이나 친구를 만나러 가는 일이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Going to meet a family member or friend who is in the military.
phrases.en_equiv: visiting a soldier at the base

phrases.en: He was assigned to a military unit near the armistice line.
phrases.nuance_ko: 군인이 일할 곳이 정해질 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a soldier is assigned a place to serve.
phrases.en_equiv: to be assigned to a military unit

explain_en: 군부대 is the military unit or the place where soldiers live and train. It is often shortened to 부대. Because of military service in Korea, you hear phrases like 부대에 들어가다 and 부대 면회.

examples.en: We have to overcome the crisis both at home and abroad.
Internal and external conditions are not good.
The plan was postponed because of internal and external factors.
Assessments at home and abroad are divided.
Building trust both inside and outside is important.
It is a difficult time both domestically and internationally.

explain: '대내외적 위기'처럼 명사 앞에 쓰고, '대내외적으로' 형태의 부사로도 많이 써요. 나라뿐 아니라 회사나 단체의 안팎에도 써요. 일상 대화에서는 '안팎으로'가 더 자연스럽고, '대내외적'은 뉴스나 발표에서 자주 들리는 딱딱한 표현이에요.

phrases.en: The company is having difficulties both internally and externally.
phrases.nuance_ko: 부사처럼 써서 안과 밖 모두에서라는 뜻을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used adverbially to mean 'both inside and outside.'

phrases.en: The economy worsened because of internal and external factors.
phrases.nuance_ko: 원인이 안팎에 모두 있다고 말할 때 뉴스나 발표에서 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in news or presentations when causes lie both inside and outside.

phrases.en: There is a lot going on at home and abroad.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서 '대내외적으로' 대신 더 자연스러운 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A more natural everyday replacement for 대내외적으로.

explain_en: It goes before a noun, as in '대내외적 위기', and is also common as the adverb '대내외적으로'. It applies to the inside and outside of a company or group as well as a country. In daily talk '안팎으로' sounds more natural, while '대내외적' is a stiff expression often heard in news and presentations.

examples.ko: 그 후보는 전체 표의 절반 가까이를 득표했어요.
examples.en: That candidate won close to half of all the votes.

examples.ko: 반장 선거에서 가장 많이 득표한 친구가 반장이 됐어요.
examples.en: The friend who got the most votes in the class president election became president.

examples.ko: 이번 선거에서 몇 퍼센트를 득표할지 궁금해요.
examples.en: I wonder what percent of the vote they'll win in this election.

examples.ko: 후보들이 득표하려고 시장을 돌며 인사를 해요.
examples.en: Candidates go around the market greeting people to win votes.

examples.ko: 많이 득표했다고 해서 꼭 당선되는 건 아니에요.
examples.en: Getting many votes doesn't necessarily mean being elected.
He got fewer votes than first place and sadly lost.

explain: '표를 얻다'와 같은 내용인데, 선거 뉴스에서 짧게 말할 때 써요. '몇 표를/몇 퍼센트를 득표하다'처럼 얻은 표의 양이 같이 나오는 일이 많고, '득표율', '득표수'라는 말도 같이 알아 두면 좋아요.

phrases.en: That candidate had the highest share of the vote.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전체 표 중 얻은 표의 비율을 말하고 선거 뉴스에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The percentage of votes won out of all votes; common in election news.

phrases.en: He won many people's votes and was elected.
phrases.nuance_ko: '득표하다'와 같은 뜻의 쉬운 표현이라 일상 대화에서 편해요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier expression with the same meaning as 득표하다, comfortable in daily talk.

phrases.example: 그 후보는 과반을 득표해서 바로 당선됐어요.
phrases.en: That candidate won more than half the votes and was elected right away.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전체 표의 절반이 넘는 표를 얻었다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means winning more than half of all votes.

explain_en: It means the same as '표를 얻다' (to get votes) but is used as a short form in election news. It often comes with the amount of votes, as in '몇 표를/몇 퍼센트를 득표하다'. It also helps to learn '득표율' (vote share) and '득표수' (vote count).

examples.ko: 그 의원은 정당 없이 무소속으로 출마했어요.
examples.en: That lawmaker ran as an independent, without a party.
An independent candidate won the election.

examples.ko: 저는 어느 동아리에도 속하지 않은 무소속이에요.
examples.en: I'm unaffiliated, not belonging to any club.

examples.ko: 무소속의 입장에서 두 당의 의견을 들었어요.
examples.en: From an independent's standpoint, I listened to both parties' views.

examples.ko: 그는 팀을 떠나 한동안 무소속 신세였어요.
examples.en: He left the team and was without a team for a while.
Since I'm independent, I don't take anyone's side.

explain: 선거와 정치 뉴스에서 '무소속 후보', '무소속 의원'처럼 가장 많이 나와요. 스포츠에서 소속 팀이 없는 선수에게도 쓰고, 반대는 '소속'이에요.

phrases.en: The independent lawmaker voted for the bill.
phrases.nuance_ko: 정치 뉴스에서 정당이 없는 국회의원을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used in political news for a lawmaker with no party.

phrases.example: 무소속 선수도 이 대회에 나갈 수 있어요.
phrases.en: Players with no team can also enter this tournament.
phrases.nuance_ko: 스포츠에서 소속 팀이 없는 선수에게도 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Also used in sports for a player without a team.

phrases.example: 저는 어느 정당에도 안 들어가서 무소속이에요.
phrases.en: I haven't joined any party, so I'm independent.
phrases.nuance_ko: '이다'를 붙여 어디에도 속하지 않은 상태를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: With 이다, it states that you belong to no group.

explain_en: Belonging to no group or party (무소속 학생, politicians) It shows up most in election and political news, as in '무소속 후보' and '무소속 의원'. It's also used in sports for a player with no team, and the opposite is '소속'.

t90.ax: An independent candidate won the election.

examples.en: The government started a nationwide campaign to save energy.

examples.ko: 이번 일은 범국민적 관심을 모으고 있어요.
examples.en: This matter is drawing nationwide attention.
Many people took part in the nationwide campaign.
Protecting the environment takes an effort by the whole nation.

examples.ko: 그 가수의 노래는 범국민적 사랑을 받았어요.
examples.en: That singer's song was loved by the whole nation.
A consensus among the whole nation has to be reached first.

explain: 뉴스나 연설에서 '범국민적 운동/노력/관심'처럼 명사 앞에 붙여 써요. 일상 대화에서는 '온 국민이', '전 국민이'라고 말하는 편이에요. '범세계적', '범시민적'처럼 '범-'이 붙으면 '전체가 함께'라는 느낌이 돼요.

phrases.en: We are reducing trash through a nationwide campaign.
phrases.nuance_ko: '운동' 말고도 '캠페인'처럼 모두가 참여하는 활동 앞에 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Besides 운동, it attaches to activities everyone joins, like 캠페인.

phrases.en: This problem needs a consensus across the whole nation.
phrases.nuance_ko: '공감대'와 함께 써서 온 국민의 같은 생각을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: With 공감대 it means a shared view among the entire nation.

phrases.example: 온 국민이 응원해서 선수들이 힘을 냈어요.
phrases.en: The whole nation cheered, and the players found strength.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서는 '범국민적' 대신 이렇게 말하는 편이 자연스러워요.
phrases.nuance_en: In everyday talk this sounds more natural than 범국민적.

explain_en: It is placed before a noun in news and speeches, as in '범국민적 운동/노력/관심'. In everyday talk people say '온 국민이' or '전 국민이' instead. With '범-', as in '범세계적', it carries the sense of everyone taking part together.

examples.en: Climate change is a worldwide problem.

examples.ko: 그 가수는 범세계적 인기를 얻고 있어요.
examples.en: That singer is gaining worldwide popularity.
It's hard to solve without global cooperation.
This brand is known all over the world.
Infectious diseases require a global response.

examples.ko: 범세계적 규모의 행사라서 준비할 것이 많아요.
examples.en: It's a global-scale event, so there is a lot to prepare.

explain: '세계적인'이 일상에서 더 편하게 쓰는 말이고, '범세계적'은 온 세상이 함께 관련된다는 무게가 있어서 뉴스나 글에서 많이 보여요. 주로 '문제, 협력, 대응' 같은 말 앞에 와요.

phrases.en: Environmental problems require worldwide cooperation.
phrases.nuance_ko: 여러 나라가 함께하는 일을 말할 때 자주 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used for efforts shared by many countries.

phrases.en: A global response is important for epidemics.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문제가 생겼을 때 온 세계가 함께 움직인다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the whole world acting together when a problem arises.

phrases.en: That singer is a world-famous star.
phrases.nuance_ko: 일상 대화에서는 '범세계적' 대신 이 말을 더 자연스럽게 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: In everyday conversation, this is the more natural word to use instead of 범세계적.

explain_en: '세계적인' is the easier everyday word, while '범세계적' carries the weight of the whole world being involved and shows up in news and writing. It mostly comes before words like '문제', '협력' and '대응'.
